subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should AI-safety events extend the existing diagnostics-stability subsystem, or become a separately owned core subsystem with its own durable schema and operator UI?
rationale: The choice determines permanent core ownership, public/plugin contracts, retention, privacy projection, gateway authorization, and whether the existing diagnostics query path may be duplicated; automation cannot safely choose that product architecture.

options.title: Extend Canonical Diagnostics
options.body: Refactor the series so the taxonomy feeds the existing sanitized diagnostics recorder and its persistence/query surfaces, adding only the filtered CLI and UI projections needed by operators.

options.title: Sponsor Dedicated Safety Subsystem
options.body: Approve a separate subsystem only with an explicit owner, SQLite schema and retention policy, bounded privacy projection, protocol descriptors, upgrade contract, and staged landing plan.

options.title: Pause The Series
options.body: Close or defer the stacked PRs until maintainers sponsor the taxonomy and operator-dashboard direction as a coordinated core feature.

recommendation.title: Extend Canonical Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Refactor the series so the taxonomy feeds the existing sanitized diagnostics recorder and its persistence/query surfaces, adding only the filtered CLI and UI projections needed by operators.

likelyOwner.reason: Telemetry and Security ownership most directly covers the event taxonomy, exporter provenance, sanitization, and operator-observability boundary.
